title: How Akai and Moog are embracing vibe-coded mods
slides: Why are Akai and Moog courting vibe coders?
Both brands opened official modding SDKs this spring
The mods are made in minutes, not months
Your synth presets may soon be crowdsourced
Try one mod before judging the hype
thread_text:
1. Why synths are dating coders

Akai and Moog just opened official modding SDKs this spring, letting anyone tweak their synth firmware. The barrier to entry collapsed overnight.

2. Minutes, not months

What used to take a team weeks of reverse engineering now takes a vibe coder an afternoon with the official toolkit. Prototypes ship before the coffee gets cold.

3. Your presets, crowdsourced

Imagine scrolling user-made mods the way you scroll sample packs. The best tweaks will float to the top and become the new default sound.

4. The hardware becomes a platform

Synths stop being finished products and start acting like app stores. Brands that win will be the ones curating the best community mods.

5. Try one before judging

Grab a free mod from the official SDK repo and load it on your gear this week. Does it actually save you time, or just add another layer to edit?
